records.question: 2018 年的 GMV 是多少？
records.sql_text: SELECT SUM(payment.payment_value) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT order_cnt.order_id), 0) AS aov FROM v_o_orders AS order_cnt JOIN v_o_payments AS payment ON order_cnt.order_id = payment.order_id WHERE NOT order_cnt.order_status IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') AND order_cnt.order_purchase_timestamp >= %(start_ts)s AND order_cnt.order_purchase_timestamp <= %(end_ts)s LIMIT 1

detail.binding_disclosure: 时间基准固定为下单时间，金额取自支付流水

gold.gold_sql:
SELECT SUM(p.payment_value) AS gmv
FROM v_o_payments AS p
JOIN v_o_orders AS o ON o.order_id = p.order_id
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-01-01'
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp <  '2019-01-01'

diffs: 列无法配对（列数相同但内容不匹配）

records.question: 2017 年每个月的订单量是多少？
records.sql_text: SELECT to_char(o.order_purchase_timestamp::timestamp, 'YYYY-MM') AS month, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_cnt FROM v_o_orders AS o WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= %(start_ts)s AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < %(end_ts)s GROUP BY to_char(o.order_purchase_timestamp::timestamp, 'YYYY-MM') ORDER BY month ASC LIMIT 100

gold.gold_sql:
SELECT STRFTIME('%Y-%m', o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS month,
       COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_cnt
FROM v_o_orders AS o
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2017-01-01'
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp <  '2018-01-01'
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY month

diffs: 列数不同：金标 2 / 预测 0

attribution.signal: 闸门自身判据缺陷：F1 排序键用了投影别名 ['month']（gate1 不登记同 scope 的投影别名 ⇒ R06）

records.question: 各州 GMV 前十名是哪些？
records.sql_text: SELECT o.customer_state AS customer_state, SUM(p.payment_value) AS gmv FROM v_o_orders AS o JOIN v_o_payments AS p ON o.order_id = p.order_id WHERE NOT o.order_status IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') GROUP BY o.customer_state ORDER BY gmv DESC LIMIT 10

detail.binding_disclosure: 时间基准固定为下单时间，金额取自支付流水

gold.gold_sql:
SELECT o.customer_state AS state,
       SUM(p.payment_value) AS gmv
FROM v_o_payments AS p
JOIN v_o_orders AS o ON o.order_id = p.order_id
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
GROUP BY o.customer_state
ORDER BY gmv DESC
LIMIT 10

records.question: 各品类商品销售额（不含运费）前十名是哪些？
records.sql_text: SELECT p.product_category AS product_category, SUM(oi.price) AS item_gmv FROM v_o_order_items AS oi JOIN v_o_orders AS ord ON ord.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN v_o_products AS p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE NOT ord.order_status IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') AND p.product_category IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.product_category ORDER BY item_gmv DESC LIMIT 10

detail.binding_disclosure: 商品金额取明细行 price，不含运费

gold.gold_sql:
SELECT pr.product_category AS category,
       SUM(i.price) AS item_gmv
FROM v_o_order_items AS i
JOIN v_o_orders AS o   ON o.order_id = i.order_id
JOIN v_o_products AS pr ON pr.product_id = i.product_id
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
GROUP BY pr.product_category
ORDER BY item_gmv DESC
LIMIT 10

records.question: 各州的平均评分是多少？
records.sql_text: SELECT o.customer_state AS customer_state, AVG(r.review_score) AS avg_review_score FROM v_o_reviews AS r JOIN v_o_orders AS o ON o.order_id = r.order_id WHERE o.customer_state IS NOT NULL GROUP BY o.customer_state ORDER BY avg_review_score DESC LIMIT 100

detail.binding_disclosure: 评分只在评价表上，按评价创建时间归属

gold.gold_sql:
SELECT o.customer_state AS state,
       AVG(r.review_score) AS avg_review_score
FROM v_o_reviews AS r
JOIN v_o_orders AS o ON o.order_id = r.order_id
GROUP BY o.customer_state
ORDER BY avg_review_score DESC

records.question: 各州的配送延迟率是多少？
records.sql_text: SELECT o.customer_state AS customer_state, 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_delivered_customer_date > o.order_estimated_delivery_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS delivery_late_rate FROM v_o_orders AS o WHERE o.order_status = %(status_delivered)s AND o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL AND o.order_estimated_delivery_date IS NOT NULL GROUP BY o.customer_state ORDER BY delivery_late_rate DESC LIMIT 100

detail.binding_disclosure: 按订单归属，分子分母同一批 delivered 单

gold.gold_sql:
SELECT o.customer_state AS state,
         SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_delivered_customer_date > o.order_estimated_delivery_date
                  THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS delivery_late_rate
FROM v_o_orders AS o
WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
  AND o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL
  AND o.order_estimated_delivery_date IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY o.customer_state
ORDER BY delivery_late_rate DESC
